 20class AdapterBase:
 21    name = ""
 22
 23    @classmethod
 24    def resolve_runnable(cls, uri, kwargs, sub) -> Runnable:
 25        from daggerml.contrib.executors._base import get_executor
 26
 27        return get_executor(cls.name, uri).resolve_runnable(uri, kwargs, sub)
 28
 29    @classmethod
 30    def send(cls, **kw) -> AdapterInvokeResponse | AdapterCleanupResponse | AdapterCancelResponse:
 31        raise NotImplementedError("Adapter send method is not implemented")
 32
 33    @classmethod
 34    def _read_input(cls, input_path: str) -> str:
 35        if input_path == "-":
 36            return sys.stdin.read()
 37        if is_s3_uri(input_path):
 38            return S3Store().get(input_path).decode("utf-8")
 39        return Path(input_path).read_text()
 40
 41    @classmethod
 42    def _write_output(cls, output_path: str, data: str) -> None:
 43        if output_path == "-":
 44            sys.stdout.write(data)
 45            if not data.endswith("\n"):
 46                sys.stdout.write("\n")
 47            sys.stdout.flush()
 48            return
 49        if is_s3_uri(output_path):
 50            parsed = urlparse(output_path)
 51            bucket = parsed.netloc
 52            key = parsed.path.lstrip("/")
 53            get_client("s3").put_object(
 54                Bucket=bucket,
 55                Key=key,
 56                Body=data.encode("utf-8"),
 57                ContentType="application/json",
 58            )
 59            return
 60        Path(output_path).write_text(data)
 61
 62    @classmethod
 63    def cli(cls, argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
 64        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=f"{cls.__name__} CLI")
 65        parser.add_argument("-i", "--input", default="-")
 66        parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", default="-")
 67        parser.add_argument("--poll", action="store_true")
 68        # FIXME: `--poll` make `cancel` difficult. We should allow for coordination between caller and this loop.
 69        args = parser.parse_args(argv)
 70        raw = cls._read_input(args.input)
 71        payload = json.loads(raw)
 72        result = cls.send(**payload)
 73        while args.poll and payload.get("operation") == "invoke" and result.get("status") == "retry":
 74            state = result.get("adapter_state")
 75            if not isinstance(state, dict):
 76                raise DmlRepoError("Retry adapter response requires object adapter_state")
 77            payload["adapter_state"] = state
 78            time.sleep(0.1)
 79            result = cls.send(**payload)
 80        if args.poll and payload.get("operation") == "invoke" and result.get("status") == "success":
 81            record = Dml(remote_root=payload["remote"]["root"]).runtime.read_execution_record(
 82                Ref(f"index:{payload['execution_id']}")
 83            )
 84            result_ref = record["state"]["result_ref"]
 85            if result_ref is None:
 86                raise DmlRepoError("Successful nested invoke did not publish a result")
 87            cleanup_payload = {**payload, "operation": "cleanup", "result_ref": result_ref}
 88            result = cls.send(**cleanup_payload)
 89            while result.get("status") == "retry":
 90                state = result.get("adapter_state")
 91                if not isinstance(state, dict):
 92                    raise DmlRepoError("Retry adapter response requires object adapter_state")
 93                cleanup_payload["adapter_state"] = state
 94                time.sleep(0.1)
 95                result = cls.send(**cleanup_payload)
 96        cls._write_output(args.output, json.dumps(result))
 97        return 0

100class LocalAdapter(AdapterBase):

102    executable = "dml-local-adapter"
103
104    @classmethod
105    def send(cls, **kw) -> AdapterInvokeResponse | AdapterCleanupResponse | AdapterCancelResponse:

107

111class LambdaAdapter(AdapterBase):
112    name = "lambda"
113    executable = "dml-lambda-adapter"
114
115    @classmethod
116    def send(cls, **kw) -> AdapterInvokeResponse | AdapterCleanupResponse | AdapterCancelResponse:
117        client = get_client("lambda")
118        try:
119            response = client.invoke(
120                FunctionName=kw["runnable"]["target"]["uri"],
121                InvocationType="RequestResponse",
122                Payload=json.dumps(kw, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8"),
123            )
124        except Exception as exc:
125            code = getattr(exc, "response", {}).get("Error", {}).get("Code")
126            if code not in {"TooManyRequestsException", "ThrottlingException"}:
127                raise
128            headers = getattr(exc, "response", {}).get("ResponseMetadata", {}).get("HTTPHeaders", {})
129            try:
130                retry_after_ms = max(0, int(float(headers.get("retry-after")) * 1000))
131            except (TypeError, ValueError):
132                retry_after_ms = None
133            result: AdapterInvokeResponse = {
134                "status": "retry",
135                "error": None,
136                "adapter_state": kw.get("adapter_state") if isinstance(kw.get("adapter_state"), dict) else {},
137            }
138            if retry_after_ms is not None:
139                result["retry_after_ms"] = retry_after_ms
140            return result
141        stream = response.get("Payload")
142        if stream is None:
143            raise DmlRepoError("Lambda adapter invoke response missing Payload")
144        return json.loads(stream.read().decode("utf-8"))
145
146
147################################################################################
148############################### Adapter registry ###############################
149################################################################################
150ADAPTER_ENTRYPOINT_GROUP = "daggerml.contrib.adapters"
151
152_LOCK = Lock()
153_ADAPTER_SPECS: dict[str, str] = {}
154_PLUGINS_LOADED = False
155
156
157def load_adapter_plugins() -> None:
158    global _PLUGINS_LOADED
159    if _PLUGINS_LOADED:
160        return
161    with _LOCK:
162        if _PLUGINS_LOADED:
163            return
164        for ep in _entry_points(ADAPTER_ENTRYPOINT_GROUP):
165            try:
166                loaded = ep.load()
167                if loaded.name in _ADAPTER_SPECS:
168                    # warn about duplicate adapter registration but allow the last one to win
169                    warn(
170                        f"Adapter: '{loaded.name}' is overwriting existing '{ep.name} ({ep.value})'",
171                        stacklevel=2,
172                    )
173                _ADAPTER_SPECS[loaded.name] = loaded
174            except Exception as e:
175                raise DmlRepoError(f"Adapter plugin '{ep.name} ({ep.value})' failed: {e}") from e
176        _PLUGINS_LOADED = True
177
178
179def get_adapter(name: str) -> Any:
180    load_adapter_plugins()
181    spec = _ADAPTER_SPECS.get(name)
182    if spec is None:
183        raise DmlRepoError(f"Adapter '{name}' is not registered")
184    return spec
185
186
187def list_adapters() -> list[str]:
188    load_adapter_plugins()
189    return sorted(_ADAPTER_SPECS.keys())
